claim: `IsFractionRing.nontrivial'` is not a fraction-ring-specific fact: from `[Algebra R S]` and `[Nontrivial S]`, `Nontrivial R` already follows from the existing `RingHom.domain_nontrivial` applied to `algebraMap R S`, so this new theorem duplicates an existing, strictly more general API under extra hypotheses.
requested_change: Remove `IsFractionRing.nontrivial'` and prove the reverse direction of `nontrivial_iff_nontrivial` directly with `(algebraMap R S).domain_nontrivial`.
